Lido and Optimism deployed on devnet 11; both confirmed smooth upgrade

testing_policy.highlight: Proposal: restrict consensus-specs test additions to CFI/SFI EIPs only in trunk branch
Consensus: EIP champions should develop tests in forks/PRs during PFI stage, merge to trunk upon CFI

Plan: merge milen's PR (legacytests#18) restoring pre-EIP-7610 tests; BAL collision behavior left undefined for now

Nethermind to update implementation to match other clients; PR review requested
